models.name: mailchimp__lists
models.description: Each record represents a list in Mailchimp, enriched with campaign metrics, (optionally) automation metrics and information about members.

columns.name: list_id
columns.description: The unique ID of a list.

columns.name: date_created
columns.description: The date and time that a list was created.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name of a list.

columns.name: list_rating
columns.description: An auto-generated activity score for the list (0-5).

columns.name: beamer_address
columns.description: The list's email beamer address.

columns.name: contact_address_1
columns.description: The street address for the list contact.

columns.name: contact_city
columns.description: The city for the list contact.

columns.name: contact_company
columns.description: The company name for the list.

columns.name: contact_country
columns.description: A two-character ISO3166 country code. Defaults to US if invalid.

columns.name: contact_state
columns.description: The state for the list contact.

columns.name: contact_zip
columns.description: The postal or zip code for the list contact.

columns.name: default_from_email
columns.description: The default from email for campaigns sent to a list.

columns.name: default_from_name
columns.description: The default from name for campaigns sent to a list.

columns.name: default_language
columns.description: The default language for a lists's forms.

columns.name: email_type_option
columns.description: Whether the list supports multiple formats for emails. When set to true, subscribers can choose whether they want to receive HTML or plain-text emails. When set to false, subscribers will receive HTML emails, with a plain-text alternative backup.

columns.name: permission_reminder
columns.description: The permission reminder for a list.

columns.name: subscribe_url_long
columns.description: The full version of a list's subscribe form (host will vary).

columns.name: subscribe_url_short
columns.description: Mailchimp's EepURL shortened version of a list's subscribe form.

columns.name: use_archive_bar
columns.description: Whether campaigns for this list use the Archive Bar in archives by default.

columns.name: visibility
columns.description: Whether this list is public or private.

columns.name: count_members
columns.description: The number of members in a list.

columns.name: most_recent_signup_timestamp
columns.description: The date of the most recent signup to a list.

columns.name: campaign_sends
columns.description: The number of sent emails from campaigns. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: campaign_opens
columns.description: The number of open events from campaign emails. The same email being opened multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: campaign_clicks
columns.description: The number of click events from campaign emails. The same email being clicked multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: campaign_unique_opens
columns.description: The unique number of emails opened from campaign emails. If a given email to a user was opened multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for opens that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: campaign_unique_clicks
columns.description: The unique number of emails clicked from campaign emails. If a given email to a user was clicked multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for clicks that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: campaign_unsubscribes
columns.description: The number of users who have unsubscribed from campaign emails. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_sends
columns.description: The number of sent emails from automations. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_opens
columns.description: The number of open events from automation emails. The same email being opened multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_clicks
columns.description: The number of click events from automation emails. The same email being clicked multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_unique_opens
columns.description: The unique number of emails opened from automation emails. If a given email to a user was opened multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for opens that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_unique_clicks
columns.description: The unique number of emails clicked from automation emails. If a given email to a user was clicked multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for clicks that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: automation_unsubscribes
columns.description: The number of users who have unsubscribed from automation emails. Set to 0 if NULL.

models.name: mailchimp__campaigns
models.description: Each record represents a campaign in Mailchimp, enriched with click, open and unsubscribe metrics.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: The ID of the campaign in Mailchimp.

columns.name: segment_id
columns.description: The ID of the Segment a campaign was sent to.

columns.name: create_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time the campaign was created.

columns.name: send_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time a campaign was sent.

columns.name: list_id
columns.description: The ID of the List a campaign was sent to.

columns.name: reply_to_email
columns.description: The reply-to email address for the campaign.

columns.name: campaign_type
columns.description: The type of campaign sent. Possible values:regular, plaintext, absplit, variate, rss.

columns.name: title
columns.description: The title of the campaign.

columns.name: archive_url
columns.description: The link to the campaign's archive version in ISO 8601 format.

columns.name: authenticate
columns.description: Whether Mailchimp authenticated the campaign. Defaults to true.

columns.name: auto_footer
columns.description: Automatically append Mailchimp's default footer to the campaign.

columns.name: clicktale
columns.description: The custom slug for ClickTale tracking (max of 50 bytes).

columns.name: content_type
columns.description: How the campaign's content is put together ('template', 'drag_and_drop', 'html', 'url').

columns.name: drag_and_drop

columns.name: fb_comments
columns.description: Allows Facebook comments on the campaign (also force-enables the Campaign Archive toolbar). Defaults to true.

columns.name: from_name
columns.description: The 'from' name on the campaign (not an email address).

columns.name: google_analytics
columns.description: The custom slug for Google Analytics tracking (max of 50 bytes).

columns.name: inline_css
columns.description: Automatically inline the CSS included with the campaign content.

columns.name: long_archive_url
columns.description: The original link to the campaign's archive version.

columns.name: status
columns.description: The current status of the campaign.

columns.name: subject_line
columns.description: The subject line for the campaign.

columns.name: template_id
columns.description: The ID for the template used in this campaign.

columns.name: timewarp
columns.description: Send this campaign using Timewarpe_this

columns.name: to_name
columns.description: The campaign's custom 'To' name. Typically the first name merge field.

columns.name: track_ecomm_360
columns.description: Whether to enable eCommerce360 tracking.

columns.name: track_goals
columns.description: Whether to enable Goal tracking.

columns.name: track_html_clicks
columns.description: Whether to track clicks in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

columns.name: track_opens
columns.description: Whether to track opens. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

columns.name: track_text_clicks
columns.description: Whether to track clicks in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to true. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

columns.name: use_conversation
columns.description: Use Mailchimp Conversation feature to manage out-of-office replies.

columns.description: The number of sent emails from campaigns. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: opens

columns.name: clicks

columns.name: unique_opens

columns.name: unique_clicks

models.name: mailchimp__campaign_recipients
models.description: Each record represents the send of a campaign email, enriched with click, open and unsubscribe metrics.

columns.name: email_id
columns.description: The ID of the email sent. Surrogate key generated from 'campaign_id' and 'member_id'. Use the dbt utils package to generate the surrogate key.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: The ID of the campaign a sent email is from.

columns.name: member_id
columns.description: The ID of the member an email was sent to.

columns.name: list_id
columns.description: The ID of the list the campaign was sent to.

columns.name: segment_id
columns.description: The ID of the segment the campaign was sent to.

columns.name: opens
columns.description: The number of open events from campaign emails. The same email being opened multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: unique_opens
columns.description: The unique number of emails opened from campaign emails. If a given email to a user was opened multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for opens that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: The number of click events from campaign emails. The same email being clicked multiple times is included in this metric. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: unique_clicks
columns.description: The unique number of emails clicked from campaign emails. If a given email to a user was clicked multiple times, it will only count once in this metric. This is the metric for clicks that is reported by Mailchimp. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: was_opened
columns.description: Whether the email sent was opened. Set to False if NULL.

columns.name: was_clicked
columns.description: Whether the email sent was clicked. Set to False if NULL.

columns.name: send_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time a campaign was sent.

columns.name: first_open_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp of the first open for an email.

columns.name: time_to_open_minutes
columns.description: The time from send to open in minutes.

columns.name: time_to_open_hours
columns.description: The time from send to open in hours.

columns.name: time_to_open_days
columns.description: The time from send to open in days.

columns.name: was_unsubscribed
columns.description: Whether the user unsubscribed via the sent email. Set to False if NULL, otherwise True.

models.name: mailchimp__campaign_activities
models.description: Each record represents an activity taken in relation to a campaign email, enriched with data about when the campaign was sent and the lag between send and the activity.

columns.description: The time from send to activity in hours.

columns.name: time_since_send_days
columns.description: The time from send to activity in days.
